title: Production deploy security objective
context: Privileged deploy operations on production configuration; not ordinary read-only support.
baseline: Privileged deployment requires hardware-rooted identity and a separate approver. No deployment may bypass either requirement.

dimensions.objective: Every administrator authenticates with hardware-bound credentials without password-only bypass.
dimensions.failure_mode: An administrator can authenticate with a reusable password alone.

dimensions.objective: Privileged production activation requires an independent authorized review before activation.
dimensions.failure_mode: The deployer can activate a production change with no independent approval.
